definitions.explanation: A declaration that one will do or refrain from doing something.
An agreement to meet at a particular time.

examples.japanese: {約束|やくそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}って→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{約束|やくそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}って→破る：02321_yaburu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけない→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧。
examples.english: You must not break a promise.

examples.english: I always make sure to keep promises with my children.

examples.english: I made plans to watch a movie with a friend, so I'm looking forward to the weekend.

notes:
{約束|やくそく} means both promise and appointment/arrangement to meet.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{約束|やくそく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

VERBAL USAGE:
{約束|やくそく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to promise, to make an appointment)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {約束|やくそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to keep a promise
- {約束|やくそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧: to break a promise
- {約束|やくそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: the appointed time
- {約束|やくそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}ける→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧: to get a commitment

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{約束|やくそく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to promise someone, to make plans with someone
- {約束|やくそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have an appointment

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: reservation (for restaurants, hotels)
- ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧: contract (formal agreement)

ASPECT (ている):
- {約束|やくそく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: has promised, has a standing commitment (resultative state, not 'is in the act of promising')
- Note: The ている form describes the state of having made a promise that still stands. ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧{約束|やくそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ = 'I have plans to meet a friend tomorrow.' Use plain {約束|やくそく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (or past {約束|やくそく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧) to describe the moment the promise was made.
